title: Interesting design but flawed – too small.
text: Interesting design but flawed – too small.. I ordered these Cube Home Olivewood mat & coaster set with high expectations. You get four of each – 4 mats and 4 coasters. I like that they are unique looking – appearing to be a slice of wood/rings inside of a tree. These are lightweight. The back is covered with a cork material. I wipe my mats off with a clean, damp cloth and follow it with a (dry) paper towel. My biggest complaint is that these mats aren’t very large. My everyday dinner plates barely fit on them. Appetizer plates would probably work better. In conclusion, if these were larger, I think I would like them a lot better.

product_metadata.title: Set of 4 Olivewood Modern Design Cork-Backed Heat Resistant Placemats and Coasters for The Dining Table. Place mats for Special Occasions, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Birthday Dinner Parties by Cube Home
features: STYLISH DESIGN - Set of 4 eye catching round placemats (11 inches diameter) and matching coasters (4.25 inches L/W) made from a robust wood-composite core, with a protective cork backing. Great looking design perfect to complement your existing home decor and the eye-catching colours make the placemats and drinks coasters ideal for any season - winter, summer, spring and autumn. Ideal for all dining settings from formal to farmhouse.

HEAT RESISTANT UP TO 212 DEGREES F (100 DEGREES C) - Protects precious furniture surfaces from heat transfer damage from hot crockery. The table mats not only effectively protect your dinner table from scratches, heat and stains, but also provide an elegant dining setting. The large-size placemats help to protect of surfaces from scuffs and spillages.
EASY-WIPE CLEAN SURFACE - PP laminated print with realistic Olive-wood surface design provides an easy-care wipe clean surface, with sealed edges to minimize staining from spillages..

MULTI USE - The placemats and coasters sets enhance indoor causal dining in the dining room or for everyday use in the kitchen. The coasters are ideal for drinks glasses, coffee mugs or cups anywhere at home.
GOOD GIFT IDEA - A good gift for all occasions including Mother’s day, New Home, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Birthdays and Valentines day.
